steps.en: Install the skill into your coding agent
steps.zh: 把这个 skill 装进你的编码 agent

steps.en: First run: setup wizard installs free CLIs and asks before reading your browser's X cookies
steps.zh: 首次运行：安装向导装好免费 CLI，读浏览器里的 X 登录前先征求同意

steps.en: Type a person, company, product or "X vs Y"
steps.zh: 输入一个人名、公司、产品，或“X vs Y”

steps.en: Your agent resolves the handles, subreddits and repos that matter and writes a query plan
steps.zh: 你的 agent 先找出相关的账号、子版块和仓库，写一份查询计划

steps.en: The engine searches every enabled source in parallel, scores by engagement and merges the same story
steps.zh: 引擎并行搜所有已启用的来源，按互动量打分，把同一件事合并成一簇

steps.en: Your agent writes one cited brief and saves it to your research folder
steps.zh: 你的 agent 写出一份带引用的简报，并存进研究目录

value.en: One cited brief of what people actually said this month across Reddit, X, YouTube and HN — you stop opening tabs thread by thread
value.zh: 一份带引用的简报，讲清本月 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN 上的真实讨论——不用再逐个翻帖子
